dshmath-manim is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Manim CE based math animation plugin: 6 built-in templates (function/derivative/integral/geometry/polar/3D surface) plus a zero-code skill pack (math-animation / manim-codegen) - natural language to animated math videos, with AST static security validation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b0993dbbd20b993f9d5d.html
